**Location:** Udyog Vihar, Gurugram  
**Company:** Novus Loyalty  
**Experience:** 3+ Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented candidate to join our team and manage proposals, RFP, RFQ, RFI, and tender-related activities. The employee will be responsible for understanding tender requirements, coordinating with internal teams, preparing and reviewing proposal documentation, ensuring compliance with submission requirements, and managing the complete tender lifecycle from requirement analysis through final submission.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and analyze **RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, tenders, and EOI documents** to understand business, technical, commercial, and compliance requirements.
* Prepare **compliance matrices, requirement checklists, bid summaries, and submission trackers**.
* Coordinate with **Sales, Product, Technology, Delivery, Finance, Legal, HR, and other internal teams** to gather required input.
* Prepare and coordinate **technical and commercial proposals** in line with client/tender requirements.
* Draft and compile responses to tender questionnaires, eligibility criteria, technical requirements, and other bid documentation.
* Ensure all required **annexures, declarations, certificates, forms, case studies, credentials, and supporting documents** are complete and properly formatted.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks in tender requirements and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for resolution.
* Maintain a centralized repository of **proposal content, case studies, company credentials, certifications, and standard responses**.
* Ensure proposals are aligned with the organization's capabilities, products, solutions, and past project experience.
* Track **submission timelines, milestones, dependencies, and approvals** to ensure bids are submitted within deadlines.
* Coordinate internal reviews and obtain necessary approvals before final submission.
* Support preparation of **presentations, capability documents, solution write-ups, and client-specific proposal decks**.
* Research client requirements and industry information to strengthen proposal responses.
* Maintain records of submitted bids, outcomes, clarifications, amendments, and post-submission communications.
* Support **pre-bid queries, clarifications, and corrigendum-related updates**.
* Continuously improve proposal templates, processes, and documentation to increase efficiency and quality.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **3+ years of relevant experience** in Business Analysis, Bid Management, Proposal Management, Tender Management, Presales, or a similar role.
* Strong experience in handling **RFP, RFQ, RFI, EOI, and government/corporate tender documentation**.
* Excellent understanding of **tender compliance and proposal submission processes**.
* Strong business writing and documentation skills.
* Excellent **MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint** skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to understand complex business and technical requirements and convert them into clear proposal responses.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with large tender documents and multiple annexures.
* Ability to manage **multiple proposals with tight deadlines**.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* **BFSI / Banking / Fintech**
* Loyalty & Rewards
* IT / SaaS / Technology Solutions
* Digital Transformation
* Government / PSU tenders

* Presales and bid management

2. Role Overview

Earth Store is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Ecommerce Executive to manage day-to-day ecommerce operations across online marketplaces and the company’s website. The candidate will be responsible for product listings, inventory coordination, order processing, sales monitoring, promotional activities, and maintaining accurate product information across online channels.

The ideal candidate should understand ecommerce platforms, be comfortable working with data, and have a strong focus on sales growth, operational accuracy, and customer experience.

3. Key Responsibilities

**A. Marketplace Management**

* Manage day-to-day operations on marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, or other relevant platforms.
* Create, update, and optimize product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, attributes, and keywords.
* Monitor product listing status, pricing, stock availability, and account health.
* Identify listing errors, suppressed products, and other operational issues and resolve them promptly.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams to resolve account and catalog-related issues.

**B. Website Management**

* Manage product uploads, pricing updates, descriptions, images, and product categorization on the company website.
* Ensure product pages are accurate, complete, and optimized for conversion.
* Monitor website orders, stock availability, and customer-facing product information.
* Coordinate with the website or technology team to resolve technical and operational issues.

**C. Order and Inventory Management**

* Monitor daily orders, cancellations, returns, and pending dispatches.
* Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfillment.
* Track inventory across marketplaces and the website to minimize stockouts and overselling.
* Maintain accurate records of stock, returns, replacements, and order discrepancies.

**D. Sales and Performance Analysis**

* Track daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance across channels.
* Monitor key metrics such as revenue, units sold, conversion rate, returns, and cancellation rate.
* Prepare regular sales and performance reports using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Identify underperforming products and recommend corrective actions.
* Track competitors’ pricing, product positioning, and promotional activities.

**E. Promotions and Campaigns**

* Coordinate marketplace sales events, promotional campaigns, and discount activities.
* Ensure product prices, offers, and campaign details are updated correctly.
* Monitor campaign performance and report results.
* Coordinate with marketing teams for product promotions and traffic-generation activities.

**F. Coordination and Reporting**

* Work closely with sales, marketing, warehouse, inventory, finance, and customer support teams.
* Maintain accurate ecommerce operational records.
* Escalate recurring issues and suggest process improvements.
* Ensure tasks are completed within defined timelines.

5. Qualifications and Experience

* Minimum 3 years of experience in ecommerce operations, marketplace management, or online retail.
* Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.

* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Problem-solving and follow-up skills.
* Understanding of online sales, product listings, inventory, and order workflows.
* A proactive attitude with a focus on ownership and continuous improvement.

* Take ownership of assigned ecommerce channels and daily operations.
* Identify issues proactively rather than waiting for instructions.

description:
Position: Account Executive

Location: Bengluru/Gurugram

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Experience Required: 2-4 years

**Job Description: Account Executive (SMB, Mid Market)**
========================================================

Job Type: Full-time | In-office | 6 days a week

**The Role**
------------

We’re hiring a driven, sharp, high-ownership Account Executive who can turn cold curiosity into clear urgency, and conversations into live trials.

We run 100+ high-quality demos every month for fast-growing D2C and Shopify brands.

In our funnel, the demo is the most critical moment. This role exists to ensure that every demo:

* Creates conviction
* Generates urgency
* Carries momentum through to trial activation

This is not a pricing-heavy closer role. It is a craft-driven sales role focused on storytelling, need generation, and follow-through.

### **North Star: Demo Booked** **Trial Activations**

**What You’ll Own?**
--------------------

* Run high-impact product demos for qualified leads
* Lead structured discovery to deeply understand the brand, category, and context
* Reframe the prospect’s problem and present a clear “better future” with our product
* Drive urgency and clarity around why the product should go live now
* Act as the single account owner from demo free-trial activation
* Follow up relentlessly and intelligently until the trial is live
* Set success criteria and next steps before the trial starts
* Conduct successful trial activation calls
* Hand off only high-intent, activated accounts to billing team

**What Success Looks Like?**
----------------------------

### **Within 30 days:**

* You independently run the majority of demos
* Your demos are structured, confident, and insight-led
* A strong percentage of demos convert into live free trials
* Trials coming from you show:
  + Faster activation
  + Higher intent
  + Cleaner downstream closes
* Sales Head/ Founder involvement is needed only for strategic or edge-case accounts

**Who Should Apply?**
---------------------

* 2 - 4 years experience in B2B SaaS sales, pre-sales, or AE roles
* Excellent communication skills, English fluency and convincing ability
* Exceptionally strong at discovery, storytelling, and framing value
* You don’t “show features”, you build narratives
* Comfortable handling high demo volume without losing quality
* Obsessed with follow-up and momentum, not dependent on reminders
* Target-driven with daily sales hygiene discipline
* High-agency operator with ownership mindset
* Bonus: Shopify, D2C, AI/ SaaS tools

**Who Should NOT Apply?**
-------------------------

* “I only do demos and hand it off” profiles
* People who disengage once the call ends
* SDRs looking for a title upgrade without ownership
* If you prefer slow, predictable roles
* If you need hand-holding
* If targets stress you
* If you seek Work life balance
* If you are not growth hungry

**Collaboration & Reporting**
-----------------------------

* SDRs hand off qualified demos
* You own the account narrative and trial activation
* Account manager executes the trial
* Sales Head handles pricing and commercial closure when required
* You report to the Sales Head

**Why Join?**
-------------

* Ownership of the most critical moment in the funnel (the demo)
* Direct access to founders (tight feedback loops, real learning)
* Six month appraisal cycle. Deliver fast, Grow faster
* Conversations with CXOs & founders of leading D2C brands, globally
* Exposure to cutting-edge AI agents and real production use-cases
* A clear path to expanded ownership as the sales org scales.

**Position services and parts as tools to:**

* Extend asset life
* Reduce maintenance expenditure
* Enhance productivity
* Improve equipment availability
* Improve return on asset investment
* Conduct equipment condition assessments and site surveys.
* Perform health checks for lifting equipment and power tools.
* Identify worn-out or safety-critical components.
* Generate inspection reports with maintenance recommendations.

* Support customers in complying with safety and statutory inspection requirements.
* Identify opportunities for equipment refurbishment and rebuild projects.
* Promote overhaul programs to restore equipment performance.
* Recommend repair solutions based on equipment condition.
* Provide customers with cost-benefit analysis of repair versus replacement.
* Coordinate repair activities with service centers and field teams.

**Promote and secure:**

* Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)

* Inspection Contracts

* Repair and Overhaul Agreements

**Responsibilities include:**

* Contract renewals

Accounts Executive – Vendor & Customer Reconciliation

**Department:** Finance & Accounts

**Designation:** Accounts Executive / Senior Accounts Executive

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, mid-level Accounts professional to manage vendor and customer account reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, outstanding balances, payment follow-ups, and resolution of discrepancies. The candidate should have strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on experience in reconciliation, and proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software.

2. Key Responsibilities

* Perform regular **vendor ledger and customer ledger reconciliation** with books of accounts and external statements.
* Reconcile vendor invoices, purchase records, debit notes, credit notes, payments, and outstanding balances.
* Reconcile customer accounts, sales invoices, receipts, credit notes, deductions, and outstanding receivables.
* Identify mismatches, duplicate entries, missing invoices, incorrect postings, and unadjusted balances.
* Coordinate with vendors, customers, procurement, sales, and internal finance teams to resolve discrepancies.
* Prepare and maintain vendor and customer ageing reports.
* Follow up on overdue customer payments and pending vendor confirmations.
* Verify invoices, payment records, bank entries, and supporting documents.
* Assist with month-end closing, ledger scrutiny, and preparation of reconciliation statements.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all reconciliation activities.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports on outstanding balances, unreconciled items, and pending resolutions.
* Support internal and statutory audits by providing reconciled statements and supporting documents.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Accounts and Finance.
* Practical experience in vendor reconciliation and customer reconciliation is essential.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, ledger scrutiny, accounts payable (AP), and accounts receivable (AR).
* Working knowledge of Tally, ERP, SAP, Oracle, or similar accounting software.
* Good command of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, and reconciliation formats.
* Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Good communication and coordination skills for resolving discrepancies with internal and external stakeholders.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and timely completion of vendor and customer reconciliations.
* Reduction in long-pending unreconciled entries.
* Timely resolution of ledger discrepancies.
* Accuracy of ageing reports and outstanding balances.
* Timely completion of month-end reconciliation activities.
* Timely follow-up and closure of pending confirmations.
* Audit readiness and completeness of supporting documentation.

5. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on accounting professional capable of independently reconciling multiple vendor and customer ledgers, investigating mismatches, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining accurate financial records.

**Preferred experience:** Candidates from manufacturing, trading, distribution, retail, or e-commerce organizations with high transaction volumes.

**Keywords for sourcing:** Vendor Reconciliation, Customer Reconciliation, Ledger Scrutiny, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Outstanding Management, Tally, SAP, ERP, Advanced Excel, Bank Reconciliation.

drive urgent cases to closure with timely customer updates.

existing customer accounts.

* Comfort with technology, internal portals and Excel/Google Sheets; able to turn operational data and

High ownership, clear communication and calm judgment under pressure. Someone who stays close to daily

title: Lead – Public Relations
description:
**Lead – Public Relations**
===========================

Gurugram, Haryana

Department **Growth & Marketing**

Job posted on **October 19, 2026**

Employee Type **permanent**

Experience range **10-20 years**

  

**About the Role**

Shiprocket is India’s largest e-commerce enablement platform, and this role exists because our story is underreported relative to our scale. We’re looking for someone who can fix that through sharp narrative instincts, deep journalist relationships, and the credibility that comes from having sat on the other side of the table.

This is a senior individual with strong execution muscle. You’ll own Shiprocket’s earned media strategy end-to-end, from proactive narrative building and executive positioning to crisis management and enterprise PR, while working as a genuine partner to the marketing function on every major GTM, brand campaign, and product launch.

**What You’ll Own**

**Narrative & Earned Media**

* Own Shiprocket’s overarching communications narrative, how we talk about ourselves across business, tech, logistics, D2C, and policy media

* Drive proactive media strategy: Understand the product and the solutions end to end, identify angles, pitch stories, and place coverage that goes beyond the press release

* Build and maintain personal relationships with senior journalists, editors, and bureau chiefs across print, digital, and broadcast. This is a relationship role as much as a strategy role

* Develop executive positioning and thought leadership for the CEO and leadership team, including op-eds, keynote narratives, and media briefings

**Marketing Partnership & GTM**

* Embed with the marketing team on every significant product launch, campaign, and GTM as a co-creator from the start. Take the lead on select GTMs where marketing becomes a support function

* Take the lead on earned and organic storytelling for launches; hand off to marketing where paid and owned amplification begins

* Represent the communications lens in campaign planning: what can PR do that advertising can’t, and how do the two reinforce each other?

* Build campaign-specific media plans with clear coverage targets, publication tiers, and spokesperson strategies

**Enterprise & B2B PR**

* Own PR strategy for Shiprocket’s enterprise and B2B audience across logistics, supply chain, retail, and D2C brand media

* Build narratives that resonate with enterprise decision-makers, not just startup press

* Support policy and regulatory communications, industry reports, and stakeholder engagement with analysts and trade publications, including DPIIT, logistics policy, and fintech-adjacent regulatory environments where Shiprocket operates

* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on case study development and customer storytelling at enterprise scale

**Crisis & Reputation Management**

* Own the crisis communications playbook. Build it, maintain it, and lead it when called upon

* Be the first call when something goes wrong: able to assess risk, draft holding statements, manage media escalation, and advise leadership in real time

* Monitor media and industry discourse continuously for emerging reputation risks and proactively flag and prepare

* Manage sensitive communications with the composure and speed that crisis demands — this is a non-negotiable capability for this role

**Stakeholder & Financial Media Communications**

* Manage communications with a complex and expanding external stakeholder map across financial media, institutional audiences, and industry analysts alongside traditional earned media

* Build and maintain relationships with financial and markets journalists (ET Markets, Mint, Bloomberg, Moneycontrol) with the same depth as business and tech media relationships

* Ensure all external communications in high-scrutiny environments are accurate, legally aligned, and consistent. Working closely with Legal, Finance, and IR teams as needed

* Manage the narrative transition that comes with significant corporate milestones: balancing growth storytelling with the discipline that more complex stakeholder environments demand

**Agency Management**

* Own the relationship with Shiprocket’s PR agency: set the brief, hold them to outcomes (coverage, not activity), and ensure strategic alignment

* Push agencies beyond execution into storytelling. Expect and demand ideas, not just delivery

* Evaluate agency performance on meaningful metrics: quality of coverage, journalist relationships built, share of voice, message penetration

**What We’re Looking For**

**Non-negotiables**

* Prior experience as a journalist. You have sat in a newsroom, filed stories under deadline, and understand how editors think about what makes news. Former journalists who have transitioned into communications bring a credibility and instinct that is very difficult to replicate.

* Exceptional written skills. We mean the ability to write a compelling op-ed, a tight press release, a crisp media pitch, and a leadership statement under pressure, all at a level that does not require heavy editing. Your writing should be a competitive advantage.

* A real journalist network that goes beyond the contact book. Senior journalists at ET, Mint, Business Standard, Forbes, TechCrunch India, and category-relevant trade publications who will take your call and give your story a fair hearing. Equally important: relationships with the financial and markets desks.

* Demonstrated crisis management. You have handled at least one significant reputational situation and can articulate what you did, why, and what the outcome was.

* Experience managing communications in high-scrutiny environments with multiple external stakeholder groups, including financial media, institutional audiences, and situations where legal and regulatory considerations shape what can be said and when.

* 10+ years of experience in PR/corporate communications, preferably within technology, eCommerce, consumer internet, startups, or high-growth organisations

**Strong advantages**

* Experience in B2B and Enterprise communications.

* Track record of working as a genuine marketing partner on GTMs

* Experience managing PR agencies from the client side and a clear point of view on what good agency performance looks like

* Familiarity with media monitoring tools and comfort using data to demonstrate PR impact beyond clip counts

* Experience building or managing a small PR team

**What Success Looks Like**

* Shiprocket appears in tier-1 business and technology media with consistent, accurate narrative

* The CEO and leadership team are recognised voices in e-commerce, logistics, and India’s startup and business ecosystem

* When a crisis occurs, we respond faster, more accurately, and with more control than our stakeholders expect

* Marketing and PR operate as one team on every major launch

* Financial and institutional media understand and accurately represent Shiprocket’s business, growth, and strategy

**About SKF**
=============

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

  

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: *www.skf.com**/in*

  

**SKF Purpose Statement**
=========================

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

  

**JOB** **DESCRIPTION**

  

**Position Title:** Sales Manager

**Reports To:** Sales Head

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

**Location:**Gurgaon

  

**Purpose of the role**

  

SKF is looking for a commercially driven Sales Manager Lubricants to actively develop the industrial lubricants and grease business in India. This is a field-oriented growth role for someone who enjoys opening doors, creating demand and converting technical customer needs into profitable business.

  

**Why we want you**

You will identify and pursue new opportunities, build a strong pipeline and grow relationships with industrial end users, original equipment manufacturers and distribution partners. Working with application specialists and the wider SKF sales organization, you will turn customer trials and early successes into repeatable business across priority industries. Your mandate will be to hunt for business, win new customers and scale successful lubrication solutions across India. Success will be visible in qualified pipeline growth, profitable sales, new customer acquisition and replication of proven applications.

**K****ey Responsibilities**

* Proactively identify, qualify and develop new lubricant and grease opportunities across the assigned market.
* Create territory and account plans, maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline and deliver agreed sales and profitability targets.
* Develop business in priority industries such as steel, cement, mining, power generation, material handling and ports.
* Grow sales through both direct customer engagement and capable industrial or lubrication distributors.
* Develop original equipment manufacturer opportunities and position SKF lubricants for initial fill, service and aftermarket needs.
* Lead the commercial side of customer trials, including opportunity qualification, stakeholder alignment, value proposition and conversion plan.
* Turn validated applications into reference cases and replicate success across customers, industries and regions.
* Monitor competitors, market prices, customer requirements and channel developments and translate insights into concrete sales actions.
* Collaborate with local and global application experts and product specialists.
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical /Chemistry/ Business or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in commercial leadership or business development.
* Strong understanding of the grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** **Business Development Manager/ Executive**

**Company:** LIVXS  
**Location:** Sector 43, Gurugram (On-site)

**Department:** Business Development  
**Verticals:** Weddings, Corporate Films, Corporate Events, Studio, Club, Learning, and Wedding Films  
**Compensation:** Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives

**1. About LIVXS**

LIVXS is a Gurgaon-based event management and creative company established in 2004. We work across weddings, corporate events, films, brand promotions, studio productions, and other creative projects, delivering professional services and memorable experiences for diverse clients and brands.

**2. Role Overview**

The Business Development Manager/ Executive will be responsible for generating leads, acquiring new clients, building business relationships, and driving revenue for their assigned vertical.

The role involves cold calling, email and WhatsApp outreach, client meetings, proposal presentations, follow-ups, and CRM management. The candidate will work closely with the Client Servicing Team and relevant internal teams to convert business opportunities into confirmed projects.

**3. Key Responsibilities** **A. Lead Generation and Client Outreach**

* Research and identify potential clients, companies, brands, agencies, and business partners relevant to the assigned vertical.
* Generate new leads through online research, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and industry directories.
* Conduct regular cold calls, cold emails, WhatsApp outreach, and follow-ups.
* Introduce LIVXS services, understand client requirements, and schedule meetings with prospective clients.

**B. Client Meetings and Proposal Coordination**

* Attend online and offline client meetings to understand requirements, budgets, and project expectations.
* Explain LIVXS services and present relevant proposals, concepts, and quotations.
* Coordinate with the Client Servicing Team for proposal preparation, costing, revisions, and presentations.
* Communicate client feedback and requirements to internal teams and follow up until the opportunity progresses.
* Support negotiations and business closures in coordination with the concerned team.

**C. Client Relationship Management**

* Maintain professional communication with prospective and existing clients.
* Coordinate with clients regarding meetings, proposals, requirements, and follow-ups.
* Build long-term relationships to encourage repeat business, referrals, and new opportunities.
* Ensure timely communication between clients and internal teams during the business development stage.

**D. CRM Management – Zoho Bigin**

* Record all leads, contacts, companies, and opportunities in Zoho Bigin.
* Update call outcomes, lead status, meeting details, proposal progress, follow-up dates, and next steps.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all client interactions.
* Track leads through the sales pipeline and update converted, lost, or inactive opportunities with appropriate remarks.
* Ensure regular follow-ups and prevent active leads from being missed.

**E. Sales Targets and Reporting**

* Work towards assigned monthly and quarterly targets for lead generation, meetings, proposals, and revenue.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline of potential clients and business opportunities.
* Share regular updates on outreach, meetings, proposals, follow-ups, and conversions.
* Coordinate with the vertical head and internal teams to review progress and resolve pending issues.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business and cross-selling wherever relevant.

**4. Vertical-Specific Responsibilities**

The employee will be assigned a particular vertical and will focus on generating relevant leads and business opportunities for it.

* **Weddings:** Connect with prospective wedding clients, families, wedding planners, venues, and industry partners.
* **Corporate Events:** Target companies, brands, HR, marketing and admin teams for corporate events, MICE, conferences, and brand activations.
* **Corporate Films:** Approach companies, brands, marketing teams, and agencies for corporate videos, brand films, promotional films, and video production.
* **Studio:** Generate leads for studio bookings, shoots, productions, and related creative services.
* **Club:** Develop business opportunities with relevant clients, brands, partners, and event organisers.
* **Learning:** Generate leads from individuals, institutions, companies, and organisations relevant to LIVXS Learning's offerings.
* **Wedding Films:** Connect with prospective wedding clients, families, planners, and partners for wedding photography and cinematography.

**5. Requirements and Skills**

* 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales, lead generation, or client acquisition.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Confidence in cold calling, email outreach, WhatsApp communication, and client meetings.
* Ability to research prospects, identify opportunities, and generate qualified leads.
* Good follow-up, coordination, and relationship management skills.
* Familiarity with CRM tools; knowledge of Zoho Bigin is an advantage.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple leads, and achieve targets.
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings when required.

**7. Why Join LIVXS?**

* Opportunity to contribute to the growth of an established creative and event management company.
* Exposure to diverse industries, clients, brands, and creative projects.
* Opportunities to build professional networks and long-term client relationships.
* Performance-based incentives linked to business results.
* A collaborative work environment involving business development, client servicing, and creative teams.

**Technical Expertise**

At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Gurgaon team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Minimum 10 years of experience managing a sales team  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

**Department:** E-Commerce & Online Sales  
**Job Title:** E-Commerce Operations Executive  
**Location:** IMT Manesar Gurugram  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years

1. Job Summary

The E-Commerce Operations Executive will be responsible for managing day-to-day online business operations for the company's wet wipes and personal hygiene products across e-commerce marketplaces and online sales channels. The role involves product listing, order processing, inventory management, marketplace coordination, pricing updates, promotional activities, sales reporting, returns management, and coordination with internal departments to ensure smooth and timely order fulfilment.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Marketplace Management

* Manage daily operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, JioMart, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.
* Create, update, and optimize product listings for wet wipes, baby wipes, facial wipes, makeup remover wipes, antibacterial wipes, and other hygiene products, as applicable.
* Maintain accurate product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, pack sizes, SKU codes, and product specifications.
* Ensure listings reflect correct product claims, ingredients, usage instructions, pack quantities, and applicable compliance information.
* Monitor listing status, product availability, suppressed listings, and marketplace performance.

B. Order Processing & Fulfilment

* Monitor and process daily orders received from different online platforms.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and dispatch teams for timely order picking, packing, invoicing, and shipment.
* Ensure the correct SKU, pack size, quantity, and product variant are dispatched against each order.
* Track order status, shipping performance, cancellations, delivery issues, and pending shipments.
* Coordinate with marketplace fulfilment facilities and logistics partners, including FBA, Easy Ship, or other applicable fulfilment models.

C. Inventory & Stock Management

* Maintain accurate inventory levels across marketplaces, warehouses, and fulfilment centres.
* Coordinate with the production and warehouse teams to ensure adequate stock availability for fast-moving SKUs.
* Monitor stock-outs, slow-moving inventory, near-expiry products, and excess stock.
* Reconcile physical stock with marketplace inventory and report discrepancies.
* Plan replenishment based on sales trends, stock availability, and upcoming promotional events.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable.

D. Sales & Performance Monitoring

* Track daily, weekly, and monthly sales, order volumes, revenue, and SKU-wise performance.
* Prepare marketplace-wise and product-wise sales reports using Excel or other reporting tools.
* Monitor key metrics such as conversion rate, return rate, cancellation rate, order defect rate, and advertising performance, where applicable.
* Identify best-selling and underperforming products and recommend corrective actions.
* Analyse competitor pricing, product positioning, customer reviews, and market trends.

E. Pricing & Promotional Activities

* Update product prices, discounts, coupons, and promotional offers as approved by management.
* Coordinate marketplace campaigns, seasonal sales, deal events, and promotional calendars.
* Support product launches, new pack-size introductions, and new SKU onboarding.
* Coordinate with the marketing team for product images, banners, A+ content, brand pages, and promotional creatives.
* Monitor promotional effectiveness and report sales outcomes.

F. Customer Service & Returns Management

* Monitor customer queries, reviews, ratings, complaints, and product feedback.
* Coordinate resolution of order-related issues, damaged products, missing items, and incorrect shipments.
* Track returns, refunds, replacements, and customer claims in accordance with marketplace policies.
* Identify recurring complaints relating to wet wipes quality, moisture retention, packaging leakage, sealing, fragrance, or product performance and escalate them to the Quality Control (QC) team.
* Maintain records of returns, customer complaints, and corrective actions.

G. Coordination with Internal Departments

* **Production:** Coordinate demand forecasts, production schedules, and product availability.
* **Warehouse & Dispatch:** Ensure accurate picking, packing, labelling, and timely shipment.
* **Quality Control:** Escalate quality complaints, packaging defects, and batch-related issues.
* **Finance & Accounts:** Coordinate invoices, marketplace settlements, deductions, returns, and reconciliation.
* **Marketing:** Support content creation, promotions, brand visibility, and advertising campaigns.
* **Sales:** Align online pricing, product assortment, channel strategy, and sales targets.

H. Documentation & Compliance

* Maintain accurate SKU master data, product specifications, pricing records, and marketplace documentation.
* Coordinate GST-related invoices, e-commerce documentation, and reconciliation with the accounts team.
* Ensure product listings and packaging information comply with applicable legal metrology, consumer protection, marketplace, and product-specific requirements.
* Maintain records of marketplace claims, returns, settlement reports, and operational issues.
* Ensure that product claims, including antibacterial or disinfectant claims where applicable, are properly approved and substantiated.

3. Required Qualifications

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in e-commerce operations, preferably in FMCG, personal care, hygiene, or manufacturing.
* Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Meesho Supplier Panel, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of inventory management, order fulfilment, returns processing, and marketplace reporting.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, including filters, pivot tables, and basic formulas.
* Understanding of GST invoices and e-commerce settlement reconciliation is preferred.

4. Required Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Attention to detail in SKU management, product listings, and order processing.
* Ability to manage multiple marketplaces and meet operational deadlines.
* Understanding of online sales trends, pricing, promotions, and customer behaviour.
* Ability to work collaboratively with production, warehouse, finance, and marketing teams.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Marketplace sales and revenue achievement.
* Order processing accuracy and on-time shipment rate.
* Product listing accuracy and listing availability.
* Inventory accuracy and reduction in stock-outs.
* Return, cancellation, and order defect rates.
* Timely resolution of customer complaints and marketplace issues.

6. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, analytical, and familiar with online marketplace operations. Experience with FMCG, baby care, personal hygiene, wet wipes, tissues, or other fast-moving consumer products will be an added advantage.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented **Senior Accountant – Finance** to manage day-to-day accounting, financial reconciliation, taxation, marketplace settlements, and MIS reporting for our growing e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of **Tally, GST, e-commerce accounting, marketplace reconciliation, banking, payment gateways, inventory accounting, and financial reporting**.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Manage day-to-day accounting entries and maintain accurate books of accounts.
* Handle purchase, sales, expenses, receipts, payments, journal entries, and ledger posting.
* Maintain proper documentation and supporting records for all financial transactions.
* Perform regular ledger scrutiny and resolve accounting discrepancies.
* Ensure timely closure of monthly accounts.

2. E-commerce & Marketplace Reconciliation

* Reconcile sales and settlements from platforms such as **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Nykaa, Blinkit and other marketplaces**.
* Reconcile marketplace orders, returns, cancellations, commissions, shipping charges, TCS/TDS, discounts, and deductions.
* Track marketplace receivables and identify pending or incorrect settlements.
* Reconcile **Shopify / website sales** with payment gateway settlements.
* Coordinate with operations and marketplace teams to resolve financial discrepancies.

3. GST & Tax Compliance

* Prepare data and support timely filing of **GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other GST returns**.
* Perform GST reconciliation between books, sales records and GST portals.
* Verify **Input Tax Credit (ITC)** and identify mismatches.
* Handle TDS-related accounting and reconciliation.
* Coordinate with CA / tax consultants for GST, TDS and other statutory requirements.

**Company Name:** My Two Bigha Pvt. Ltd. (2Bigha)  
**Job Location:** Sector 59, Gurugram, Haryana  
**Department:** Sales  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week  
**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and target-oriented **Sales Executive** who can generate leads, connect with potential customers, explain our subscription plans, and convert prospects into paying subscribers. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to achieve sales targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Contact potential customers through calls, WhatsApp, and other communication channels to promote 2Bigha's subscription plans.
* Explain subscription benefits, features, pricing, and value propositions to prospective customers.
* Convert interested leads into paid subscriptions and consistently achieve assigned sales targets.
* Follow up with prospective customers to close deals and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Generate new leads and explore opportunities to increase subscription sales.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, follow-ups, conversions, and sales activities in the CRM or designated tracking system.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships to encourage renewals and repeat business.
* Coordinate with the marketing and other relevant teams to improve lead conversion and sales performance.
* Provide regular updates on sales performance, customer feedback, and daily activities to the reporting manager.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Graduate in any stream (BBA, B.Com, BA or equivalent preferred).
* Freshers and candidates with prior sales or business development experience can apply.
* Good verbal communication and convincing skills.
* Confidence in handling customer queries, objections, and follow-ups.
* Target-oriented, self-motivated, and willing to learn.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM tools is an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to learn and grow in a startup environment.
* Performance-based incentives as per company policy.
* Practical exposure to sales, customer relationship management, and subscription-based business.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at **hiring@2bigha.ai**.

**Join 2Bigha and grow your career in sales!**

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: PPC Executive
description:
**Job Description: PPC Executive (Production Planning & Control)**

**Industry:** Printing & Paper Converting (paper cups, containers, lids, plates, food packaging)  
**Experience:** 3 to 5 years  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per month (based on experience and skills)  
**Reports to:** Production Manager / Plant Head

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a PPC Executive to plan and control daily production across our printing and paper converting machines. You will make sure job cards are issued on time, machines run efficiently, raw material is available, and customer orders are delivered as committed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare daily and weekly production plans for all machines, shift-wise (Day/Night), based on order priority and delivery dates.
* Create and issue job cards with correct machine number, product, size, quantity and operator details.
* Coordinate with the Stores/Purchase team to ensure paper, PE-coated board, kraft, inks and other materials are available before production.
* Plan machine loading to minimize changeovers, mould/die changes and idle time.
* Track production against plan, and follow up on delays, breakdowns and shortages.
* Maintain production, wastage and dispatch records, and report daily output and rejection to management.
* Coordinate with the Printing, Die-cutting, Forming and Packing departments for smooth workflow.
* Work with the Sales/Dispatch team on order status, delivery schedules and urgent requirements.
* Monitor wastage, machine efficiency and OEE, and suggest improvements.
* Keep stock of finished goods and semi-finished goods updated.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Graduate or Diploma (B.Com, BBA, B.Sc, or a Diploma in Printing/Packaging/Mechanical preferred).
* **3 to 5 years of PPC experience in printing and paper converting or packaging**, such as paper cups, paper containers, lids, plates or flexible/folding carton.
* Good knowledge of paper cup and container machines, printing, flexo or offset processes, and die-cutting.
* Understanding of raw material specifications (GSM, PE coating, kraft/white board) and material consumption calculations.
* Proficient in MS Excel, and familiar with ERP or production software.
* Strong coordination, follow-up and communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple shifts and urgent orders.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a high-volume, multi-machine plant.
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing, 5S or wastage reduction.

**What We Offer**

* ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per month
* Stable job in a growing manufacturing unit
* Growth opportunity based on performance

**To apply:** Send your resume to [ hrexecutive@mahalaxmipackaging.com ].

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

* How many years of PPC experience do you have in printing or paper converting?
* What is your current salary and your expected salary? (Our budget is ₹30,000 to ₹40,000.)

Job Description

**The Komax group is a pioneer and market leader in the field of automated wire processing. As a globally active Swiss company, we develop and manufacture serial production machines, customer-specific systems, quality assurance modules, test systems, networking solutions, and services for various industries. The Komax group has more than 50 companies with 3500 employees across five continents and a worldwide sales and service network.**

Sales Engineer - Aerospace & Railways

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled **Sales Engineer - Aerospace & Railways** to join our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering and sales, contributing to the growth and success of advanced solutions within the aerospace and railway sectors.

As a Sales Engineer, you will leverage your deep understanding of aerospace and railway technologies to develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proposals that meet customer requirements and industry regulations. You will play a critical role in identifying customer needs, shaping product offerings, and driving strategic sales initiatives.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Collaborate closely with sales representatives and engineering teams to customize solutions tailored to client specifications in aerospace and railway domains.
* Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations to customers, highlighting the features, benefits, and competitive advantages of our offerings.
* Analyze customer requirements and provide expert recommendations on product configurations and implementations.
* Support the preparation and submission of detailed technical proposals, bids, and contracts in compliance with industry standards and regulations.
* Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive products to anticipate market needs and advise on product development.
* Facilitate training sessions and workshops for clients and internal teams to enhance product knowledge and application effectiveness.
* Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with customers, partners, and stakeholders in the aerospace and railway sectors.
* Participate in trade shows, conferences, and industry events to promote our solutions and establish professional networks.

**Qualifications and skills:**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably aerospace, mechanical, electrical, or a related field.
* Proven experience in sales engineering or technical sales within aerospace, railway, or related industries.
* Strong technical aptitude combined with excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into clear and persuasive messaging tailored to diverse audiences.
* Familiarity with aerospace and railway industry standards, safety regulations, and certification processes.
* Self-driven, customer-focused, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with CRM software and Microsoft Office suite; experience with industry-specific engineering tools is a plus.
* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

**About our company:**

We are a forward-thinking company committed to technological innovation and excellence in the aerospace and railway sectors. Our inclusive and collaborative culture fosters growth and encourages creative problem-solving. Joining us means becoming part of a team that values expertise, diversity, and a shared passion for advancing transportation solutions that make a meaningful impact globally.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
**Zone Head — Delhi (North)**

Own the North. Build a market from the ground up, across every channel that buys.

**Reports to**

Sales Head

**Vertical**

Sales — Offline & Corporate

**Territory**

Delhi NCR & North zone

**Team**

One Techno-Sales Engineer; grows with the zone

**Works with**

Central pre-sales (leads), Offline Services (handover), Design & Specification

**The role in one paragraph**

Incygys sells home automation, central vacuum and clean-air systems — a category still finding its feet in India and growing fast. In the North, we have engineers on the ground and installations running, but no one carrying a sales bag. You are that person. You own every rupee of North-zone revenue, from whatever source it comes: leads the digital team generates and hands to you, dealers you appoint, and the architects, MEP consultants, builders and corporates who specify systems into their projects. This is a build, not a handover — you are being hired to create a market, not maintain one.

**What you own**

* **The zone number.** Full responsibility for North-zone sales — revenue and margin. Every channel in the territory rolls up to you.
* **Digital-qualified leads.** Leads generated by the central digital team are handed to you with a commitment to convert. Speed and follow-through on these is non-negotiable.
* **Channel — dealers.** Appoint, activate and manage dealers across the zone. Dealers are how you cover geography without carrying headcount.
* **Specification sales.** Work architects, MEP consultants and interior firms so Incygys is written into the drawings before the customer ever shops — the highest-quality demand there is.
* **Projects & corporates.** Sell into builders, developers and corporate fit-outs where central vacuum and clean-air systems belong in the base spec.
* **Clean handover.** Once a deal closes, hand it cleanly to Offline Services and Projects with the paperwork complete, so delivery starts without chasing you.

**What the first six months should produce**

This role is judged on pipeline built and revenue closed, not activity. By month six we expect:

* A live, weighted pipeline you can walk through deal by deal — not a list of names.
* First dealers appointed and selling, with a plan to widen coverage across the zone.
* A working relationship with at least a handful of architect / MEP firms who now specify Incygys.
* Digital-sourced leads converting at a rate you and the Sales Head have agreed and can defend.
* First corporate or builder project won, proving the specified-sale motion works in the North.

**What you bring**

* Five or more years in field sales, ideally in building products, electricals, HVAC, appliances, automation or a comparable considered-purchase category sold into homes and projects.
* Real command of at least two of: dealer / channel development, architect and MEP specification selling, and project / corporate sales. Strength across all three is what makes this role sing.
* A genuine North-zone network — dealers, consultants, builders you already know — and the credibility to open doors from day one.
* The temperament for a build: comfortable being the first salesperson in a territory, creating pipeline rather than inheriting it.
* Discipline with a CRM and clean handovers — you close, then you hand over properly, so delivery and follow-up run without you.
* Fluent in the North market; a driving licence and willingness to be on the road across NCR and the zone.

**Helpful, not essential**

* Exposure to central vacuum, home automation or clean-air / IAQ products.
* An existing dealer or specifier network specifically in Delhi NCR.
* Experience opening a new territory or launching a category from scratch.

**How success is measured**

One primary number, and the pipeline discipline behind it:

* **North-zone revenue and margin —** the number the role lives by, measured monthly against plan.
* **Pipeline health —** coverage, conversion and dealer / specifier additions. A strong pipeline is what makes the revenue number repeatable rather than lucky.

You will be given leads, a brand and engineers already in the field. What you add is the selling — and that is exactly what you will be measured on.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

We provide the trusted foundation operators need to run their rail networks, being **"Your partner for confidence."**

* We are seeking a driven and technically sound **Assistant Manager – Business Development** to strengthen our presence in the railway signalling sector. The ideal candidate should have strong understanding of signalling systems.

title: Cold Email Lead Generation Executive
description:
Job Title

**Cold Email Lead Generation Executive**

Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Cold Email Lead Generation Executive** to build accurate prospect databases and generate qualified business leads through targeted cold email campaigns.

The role involves business data extraction, decision-maker research, email discovery and verification, campaign management, email deliverability, and performance optimization. You will use prospecting platforms, automation tools, and AI-powered solutions to reach relevant businesses and generate genuine sales opportunities.

Success is measured by verified prospects, strong email deliverability, positive replies, and qualified leads—not simply the number of emails sent.

What You’ll Do

**1. Business Data Extraction and Prospect Research**

* Extract business information from Google Maps, online directories, company websites, LinkedIn, and other public sources.
* Build targeted prospect lists based on industry, location, business type, company size, and other relevant criteria.
* Identify key decision-makers, including Founders, Business Owners, Directors, CEOs, and Marketing Heads.
* Research company details and enrich existing databases using prospecting platforms, AI tools, and data enrichment solutions.

**2. Email Finding, Verification, and Database Management**

* Find relevant business email addresses for identified decision-makers.
* Verify email addresses before launching campaigns to reduce bounce rates and protect sender reputation.
* Clean, organize, deduplicate, and segment prospect databases.
* Maintain accurate records of company information, contact details, campaign status, and lead quality.
* Regularly update prospect lists to maintain data accuracy and usability.

**3. Cold Email Campaign Setup and Management**

* Set up and manage sending domains, email inboxes, and campaign infrastructure.
* Configure and monitor email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Manage appropriate inbox warm-up practices and sending volumes to support email deliverability.
* Create and run targeted cold email campaigns with personalized messaging and automated follow-up sequences.
* Use AI writing tools and automation platforms to improve research, personalization, and campaign efficiency.
* Ensure email campaigns follow relevant email marketing, privacy, and anti-spam requirements.

**4. Email Deliverability and Campaign Optimization**

* Monitor bounce rates, spam complaints, inbox placement, reply rates, and other campaign performance indicators.
* Identify and resolve deliverability issues promptly.
* Test subject lines, email copy, calls to action, audience segments, and targeting strategies.
* Analyze campaign results and continuously improve messaging and targeting to generate more positive replies.
* Maintain unsubscribe lists and suppression lists to avoid contacting recipients who have opted out.

**5. Lead Qualification and Reporting**

* Monitor incoming replies and identify prospects with genuine interest in the agency’s services.
* Qualify positive responses based on business requirements and potential fit.
* Forward qualified leads and relevant conversation details to the sales team.
* Maintain campaign records, prospect databases, and performance reports.
* Track verified contacts, deliverability, positive replies, and qualified leads to measure campaign effectiveness.

Tools and Platforms

* Google Maps and online business directories
* Apollo.io and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Clay, Hunter, Snov.io, RocketReach, and Lusha
* Email verification and data enrichment tools
* Instantly, Smartlead, and lemlist
* Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
* CRM platforms
* Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
* AI-powered research, writing, and automation tools

Who Can Apply

* Candidates interested in cold email outreach, B2B lead generation, prospect research, or email campaign management.
* Individuals with strong online research skills and attention to detail.
* Candidates who can build accurate prospect lists and identify relevant business decision-makers.
* Applicants who understand email verification, database management, and campaign performance tracking.
* Candidates who are comfortable using prospecting tools, email automation platforms, and AI-powered tools.
* Individuals who can work systematically, troubleshoot campaign issues, and focus on generating qualified leads.

Required Skills

* Strong internet research and business data extraction skills.
* Knowledge of B2B prospecting and decision-maker identification.
* Familiarity with email-finding, verification, and data enrichment tools.
* Understanding of cold email campaign setup, personalization, and automated follow-ups.
* Basic knowledge of email deliverability, sender reputation, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Ability to analyze campaign metrics, troubleshoot delivery issues, and optimize reply rates.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and accurate database management.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, email automation tools, and AI-powered workflows.
* Understanding of unsubscribe management, suppression lists, and responsible email outreach practices.
* A results-driven approach focused on verified prospects, positive replies, and qualified business opportunities.

**About HolidayAlong**

HolidayAlong Hospitality LLP is a travel and hospitality company focused on creating memorable travel experiences through customised holiday packages, hotel bookings, sightseeing arrangements, transfers and personalised travel planning.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, customer-focused and sales-oriented **Travel Sales Executive / Holiday Planner** who can understand travellers' requirements, design suitable holiday packages, manage enquiries and convert prospective customers into confirmed bookings.

If you enjoy travelling, communicating with people, planning holidays and achieving sales targets, we would love to hear from you.

**Job Profile**

As a Travel Sales Executive / Holiday Planner, you will be responsible for managing customer enquiries, recommending suitable destinations and holiday packages, preparing customised itineraries, coordinating with suppliers and closing bookings. You will work closely with the operations team to ensure a smooth customer experience from the initial enquiry to the completion of the trip.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Travel Sales & Lead Management**

* Handle incoming enquiries from customers through telephone, WhatsApp, email, social media and other company channels.
* Understand customers' travel preferences, budget, destination, travel dates, group size and special requirements.
* Recommend suitable domestic and international holiday packages based on customer needs.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the company's revenue growth.
* Maintain a professional relationship with customers and encourage repeat bookings and referrals.

**2. Holiday Planning & Itinerary Preparation**

* Design customised holiday packages for couples, families, groups, honeymooners and other travellers.
* Prepare detailed day-wise itineraries covering destinations, sightseeing, transfers, hotels, activities and inclusions.
* Calculate package costs, prepare quotations and explain inclusions, exclusions, payment terms and cancellation policies.
* Suggest alternative hotels, destinations and travel options based on customers' budgets.
* Ensure quotations and itineraries are accurate, attractive and commercially viable.

**3. Supplier & Operations Coordination**

* Coordinate with hotels, transport vendors, destination management companies (DMCs), tour operators and other suppliers.
* Obtain hotel availability, negotiated rates and supplier quotations before confirming offers to customers.
* Coordinate with the operations team for confirmed bookings, vouchers, transfers and other travel arrangements.
* Follow up on pending confirmations, payments, amendments and cancellations.
* Ensure a smooth handover of confirmed bookings to the operations team.

**4. Customer Relationship Management**

* Maintain regular communication with customers throughout the booking process.
* Address customer queries, objections and concerns professionally.
* Keep customers updated about quotations, payment deadlines, booking confirmations and travel arrangements.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow-ups, quotations, sales and booking status.
* Provide appropriate assistance in coordination with the operations team if a customer encounters an urgent travel-related issue.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a tourism or hospitality qualification will be preferred.
* Prior experience in travel sales, holiday planning, tour operations or the hospitality industry is desirable.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong sales, negotiation, persuasion and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to understand travel requirements and recommend suitable packages.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email, WhatsApp Business and online communication tools.
* Ability to prepare quotations, calculate package costs and manage multiple enquiries.
* A target-oriented attitude, positive approach and willingness to learn.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will have an advantage:

* Domestic and international holiday packages.
* Customised itineraries and tour package costing.
* B2C travel sales and lead conversion.
* B2B travel agent coordination.
* Hotel reservations, supplier negotiations and destination knowledge.
* CRM software, lead tracking and sales reporting.

**Performance Expectations**

The selected candidate will be expected to:

* Respond to assigned customer enquiries within the company's service timelines.
* Follow up regularly on pending quotations and prospective bookings.
* Achieve mutually agreed monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Maintain accurate quotations, lead records and booking details.
* Build positive customer relationships and contribute to repeat business.
* Coordinate effectively with the operations team to ensure customer satisfaction.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance-based incentives on eligible sales, as per company policy.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in travel sales, destination knowledge and holiday planning.
* Professional growth in the travel and hospitality industry.
* Supportive working environment with opportunities to take ownership of customer relationships.

**Working Conditions**

* Full-time, on-site position.
* Working days, office timings and weekly offs will be communicated during the interview.
* Occasional flexibility may be required during peak travel periods or for urgent customer travel issues, in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may apply through Indeed with their updated resume. Candidates with relevant travel sales experience should mention their previous responsibilities, sales experience and familiarity with holiday packages.

**Join HolidayAlong and help travellers turn their holiday plans into memorable experiences!**

GURGAON, IN, 122001

At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. Regular interaction with internal customers including Directors with Sales, Finance and Supply Chain. title: MANAGER- PRE SALES& LEAD CONVERSION
description:
Position: MANAGER – PRE\-SALES \& LEAD CONVERSION

Department: Sales \& Pre\-Sales

Location: Gurugram

Reporting To: Business Head / Director – Sales

Experience: 4–8 years in Real Estate Pre\-Sales, Tele\-Sales, Lead Conversion or Customer Acquisition

Industry Preference: Residential Real Estate / Luxury Real Estate / Plotted Developments / Premium Housing

Salary: 6 Lakh\-9Lakh/Year

⸻

1\. ROLE PURPOSE

The Manager – Pre\-Sales \& Lead Conversion will be responsible for managing the complete pre\-sales process from the time a lead is received until it is successfully converted into a qualified prospect and site visit.

The role requires strong communication, sales follow\-up, lead nurturing and team\-coordination skills, with a sharp focus on lead\-to\-site\-visit conversion.

The candidate will act as the primary link between Digital Marketing, Pre\-Sales and the Sales/Closing Team.

⸻

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Lead Management

\* Receive and monitor leads generated through Meta, Google, portals, website, WhatsApp and other marketing channels.

\* Ensure all fresh leads are contacted promptly.

\* Understand the prospect’s requirement, budget, location preference, purpose of purchase and purchase timeline.

\* Categorise leads into Hot, Warm, Cold and Not Qualified.

\* Maintain accurate lead records and follow\-up status in the CRM/database.

B. Lead Calling \& Qualification

\* Personally handle important/fresh incoming leads.

\* Conduct structured telephonic conversations to understand customer requirements.

\* Explain relevant project/product information and generate customer interest.

\* Identify genuine buyers and prioritise leads based on buying intent.

\* Handle initial objections related to price, location, project, payment plans and possession timelines.

\* Qualify prospects before transferring them to the Sales Team.

C. Follow\-up \& Lead Nurturing

\* Establish a systematic follow\-up process for every qualified lead.

\* Maintain regular contact through calls and WhatsApp.

\* Follow up with customers who are not immediately ready to visit.

\* Reactivate old, dormant and previously unresponsive leads.

\* Develop long\-term relationships with prospects until they are ready for a site visit.

\* Ensure no genuine lead is left unattended or without a defined next follow\-up date.

D. Site Visit Conversion

\* Convert qualified enquiries into confirmed site visits.

\* Coordinate with the Sales Team regarding availability and customer requirements.

\* Confirm site\-visit appointments with customers.

\* Send relevant project information, location details and appointment confirmations through WhatsApp.

\* Follow up with customers who cancel, postpone or do not turn up.

\* Track Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment → Site Visit conversion.

E. Team Management

\* Supervise the Pre\-Sales / Telecalling Executive(s).

\* Allocate leads and databases appropriately.

\* Monitor daily calling and follow\-up activity.

\* Review pending follow\-ups and ensure timely action.

\* Conduct daily/weekly performance reviews with the telecalling team.

\* Train team members on calling scripts, project knowledge, objection handling and follow\-up techniques.

\* Escalate high\-value and high\-intent prospects to the Sales/Closing Team.

F. CRM \& Reporting

\* Ensure complete and accurate CRM/database updation.

\* Maintain records of calls, conversations, follow\-ups and customer requirements.

\* Prepare daily and weekly pre\-sales reports.

\* Track source\-wise lead performance.

\* Monitor lead ageing and follow\-up pending reports.

\* Provide feedback to Digital Marketing regarding lead quality and campaign performance.

⸻

3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

The role will primarily be measured on quality and conversion, not merely the number of calls made.

Primary KPIs

\* Lead\-to\-Contact Ratio

\* Qualified Lead Conversion

\* Lead\-to\-Site\-Visit Conversion %

\* Number of Qualified Site Visits Generated

\* Site Visit Show\-up Ratio

\* Follow\-up Completion %

\* Lead Response Time

\* Old/Cold Lead Reactivation

\* Sales\-qualified leads handed over to Sales Team

Secondary KPIs

\* CRM accuracy and discipline

\* Daily calling productivity

\* Follow\-up ageing

\* Customer response rate

\* Team productivity

\* Lead quality feedback to Marketing

⸻

4\. DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Manager is expected to:

1\. Review all fresh leads received.

2\. Ensure immediate contact with new enquiries.

3\. Review pending follow\-ups.

4\. Personally handle high\-value/high\-intent prospects.

5\. Monitor the telecalling executive’s activity.

6\. Qualify prospects and schedule site visits.

7\. Coordinate confirmed visits with the Sales Team.

8\. Review cancelled/no\-show visits and initiate re\-follow\-up.

9\. Update CRM and ensure every active lead has a clear next action.

10\. Submit an end\-of\-day performance report.

⸻

5\. REQUIRED SKILLS

\* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

\* Strong telephonic sales and follow\-up ability.

\* Good understanding of real estate sales cycles.

\* Ability to identify genuine buying intent.

\* Strong objection\-handling and negotiation skills.

\* Excellent follow\-up discipline.

\* Customer relationship management skills.

\* Ability to work with CRM and lead\-management systems.

\* Strong ownership of targets and results.

\* Ability to manage and motivate a small pre\-sales team.

\* Professional and presentable personality.

⸻

6\. CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate should be:

\* Experienced in real estate pre\-sales / inside sales / tele\-sales.

\* Comfortable handling high\-value residential property enquiries.

\* Target\-oriented and persistent without being overly aggressive.

\* Strong at converting conversations into appointments and site visits.

\* Comfortable working with digital leads from Google and Meta campaigns.

\* Capable of managing both fresh and old databases.

\* Data\-driven and disciplined in CRM usage.

Experience with premium/luxury residential projects, plotted developments, floors, villas or NRI clientele will be an advantage.

⸻

7\. AUTHORITY \& OWNERSHIP

The Manager will have ownership of the pre\-sales funnel from lead receipt until site\-visit generation.

The position is expected to work closely with:

Digital Marketing → Pre\-Sales → Sales → Site Team → Closing

The Manager will also provide regular feedback to Management regarding:

\* Lead quality

\* Campaign performance

\* Customer objections

\* Market response

\* Pricing feedback

\* Competitor activity

\* Reasons for lead drop\-offs

⸻

8\. SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

The Manager will be considered successful when the organisation consistently achieves:

MORE QUALITY LEADS → FASTER RESPONSE → BETTER QUALIFICATION → STRONGER FOLLOW\-UP → MORE SITE VISITS → MORE SALES

The core objective is simple:

“Every genuine enquiry must be systematically followed up and converted into a qualified sales opportunity and, wherever possible, a site visit.”

Apply Now: Send your CV/Resume to us.:

9667542182

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month
